svg.title: AppStatusStore -- Live KVStore vs History Server Replay
svg.desc: AppStatusListener -> ElementTrackingStore (InMemoryStore) -> AppStatusStore -> SparkUI vs separate History Server KVStore. 1. LiveListenerBus to AppStatusStore: JobStart / TaskEnd / Metrics (driver-1 in-JVM); 2. AppStatusStore to AppStatusStore: Write KVStore wrappers (driver-1 in-JVM); 3. Live Spark UI to AppStatusStore: jobsList & executorList (driver-1 in-JVM); 4. AppStatusStore to Live Spark UI: v1.JobData / ExecutorSummary (driver-1 in-JVM); 5. LiveListenerBus to Spark Event Log: Write JSONL event log (driver-1 in-JVM); 6. Spark Event Log to HDFS NameNode: create / addBlock (meta) (nn01:8020); 7. Spark Event Log to HDFS DataNode: Stream 4.2 MB JSONL log (dn01:9866); 8. HDFS NameNode to History Server: getBlockLocations(meta) (nn01:8020); 9. HDFS DataNode to History Server: Read 4.2 MB -> History KVStore (dn01:9866)
